The '''''Voxen Tass''''' was a modified [[Brayl-class bulk freighter|''Brayl''-class bulk freighter]] that was operational during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Captained by [[Leona Makk]], the ''Voxen Tass'' was a ship from [[Shang Lines]]. At one point it delivered an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] strike team to [[Argovia]], where the team destroyed a [[Sensor/Legends|sensornet]] established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
